captions.linkedin:
Hurst, Ooi & Pedersen ran TIME-SERIES MOMENTUM across 67 futures markets going back to 1880. Every single decade was profitable. 13 decades, zero losing ones.

That's not a backtest curve. That's 136 years of mechanical trend following surviving wars, depressions, oil shocks, and central bank regimes.

The construction is plain:

🔹 MACD ENSEMBLE, three channel crossovers per instrument
🔹 MULTI-HORIZON, 1, 3, 12 month blended signal
🔹 VOL SCALING, per-market risk standardization
🔹 EQUAL-RISK weighting, parity across 50 to 70 markets
🔹 CRISIS ALPHA, profitable in equity drawdowns
🔹 DAILY REBALANCE, continuous position adjustment

The SG Trend Index tracks live audited CTA returns, so this isn't a paper claim. The post-2010 decay is real and visible in the data. Crowding compressed the lean period from 2011 to 2019.

Moskowitz, Ooi & Pedersen (JFE 2012). Hurst, Ooi & Pedersen (2017).

Moskowitz-Ooi-Pedersen & Hurst-Ooi-Pedersen papers; educational only, not investment advice.
